title: DECISIVE Tool Pilot Trial
official: DECISIVE (Decisions and Expectations in Cytoreduction: Informed Surgery Incorporating Value Exploration) Stage 2: Measuring the Impact of the DECISIVE Tool on Decisional Outcomes for Cytoreductive Surgery
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the provided educational material and decision-making support related to cytoreductive surgery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Scheduled for an upcoming new-patient consultation through the Yale PSM Program for evaluation of cytoreductive surgery
* Has not yet made a final treatment decision regarding cytoreductive surgery at the time of recruitment
* Able to provide informed consent
* Able to receive electronic communication (email or text) to access the DECISIVE tool
* English-speaking (for this version of DECISIVE)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously completed the DECISIVE tool as part of earlier study stages
* Significant cognitive impairment precluding informed consent
* No upcoming evaluation for cytoreductive surgery through the Yale PSM Program
